name: simplepixelart-mcp
description: Turn images into pixel art, extract and remap palettes, and upscale sprites without blur.
long_description: Local pixel art tools for AI assistants: convert photos to pixel art with median-cut colours or palettes like PICO-8, Game Boy and ENDESGA 32, extract .gpl palettes, recolour sprites to a palette and upscale with nearest neighbour. Works on PNG and JPEG files or image URLs. No API keys.

tools.name: pixelate_image
tools.description: Turn a photo or illustration into pixel art: shrink it to a pixel grid, reduce it to a few colours (or a named palette) and save a PNG. Accepts a local PNG/JPEG path or an http(s) URL.

tools.name: extract_palette
tools.description: Pull the main colours out of an image (median cut). Returns hex codes plus a GIMP/Aseprite .gpl palette.

tools.name: remap_palette
tools.description: Recolour an existing pixel art image so every pixel uses a colour from the given palette (e.g. PICO-8 or Game Boy). Size is kept.

tools.name: upscale_pixel_art
tools.description: Scale pixel art up by a whole number with nearest neighbour, so pixels stay sharp (for previews, store pages or social posts).

tools.name: list_palettes
tools.description: List the built-in pixel art palettes and their colours.
